subject: Insurance
title: The Uninsurable Future
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Uninsurable Future.

hook.text: Swiss Re estimates that climate change could make insurance unavailable for hundreds of millions of people by 2050.

buildup.text: Rising seas, fiercer storms, and longer droughts are pushing risk beyond what markets can price or absorb.

discovery.text: When insurance withdraws, property values collapse. No insurance means no mortgages, no mortgages means no buyers.

twist.text: Governments become the insurer of last resort—but taxpayers funding disaster bailouts is just hidden insurance.

climax.text: The question isn't whether we pay for climate risk. It's whether we pay through premiums, taxes, or unrecovered loss.

punchline.text: Premiums, taxes, or ruin. Climate risk always finds a payer.

quiz.question: What happens to property values when insurance becomes unavailable?
options: They collapse because no mortgages can be obtained
